title: Kannada Sign Language Recognition
subtitle: AI/ML Full Stack Tool
details: A real-time Kannada Sign language detection application (Python, OpenCV, Flask, HTML/CSS/JS) trained on 15,000+ custom gesture datasets. Conducted a case study on a student from AIISH, Mysuru.
Published Research Paper: "Implementation of Kannada Sign Language Recognition using Machine Learning" in IJARCCE.

title: Telegram bot for Indian Supermarket store
subtitle: AI agent bot
details: A telegram AI bot with harness, with database CRUD operation tools for easy natural language command-based inventory, account and invoice management, GSTinvoice and sales PPT generations. (Python, Gemini SDK, AI agents, Harness, Telegram API)
Used Google Antigravity AI as a leverage to make fast paced progress.

title: Telegram drive
subtitle: In progress
details: Online drive like interface to store files in telegram storage. Files will be uploaded to saved messages or a specified chat and retrieved through Telegram APIs (Python, React, Vite, Telegram API)

title: Bidirectional visitor counter with limit
subtitle: Arduino based sensing system
details: Counts the no. of visitors entering & leaving the room using IR sensing mechanism. Integrated buzzer with limit trigger. (Arduino IDE)
